'''Karrus Vayl''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Empire]] who was brought over to the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]] by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Cyman Walz]] and then inducted into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="Cyman" />
